title: Mixed mineable
description: With this data pack, all your tool specialties will be mixed up.
body:
With this data pack, all your tool specialties will be mixed up. To break blocks that a pickaxe can break, you'll need a hoe, and to break wood, you'll need a pickaxe. This data pack may make the game more challenging. Each data pack version also has its own variety, so if you want to experience more randomness, just download a different version!

[Video (RU)](https://youtube.com/shorts/M76HBQq2fuE?si=94PGJNfzA6zXut9L)
